(201)chos dbang spu gri'i bzlog pa khro bcu tshig sna bsdus pa/hūm̐/chos dbyings ngang la snying rje yi/rtsal snang dur khrod gzhal yas khang*/rab 'bar 'khor la

tei:div.tei:p: chos dbang spu gri'i bzlog pa khro bcu tshig sna bsdus pa/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ngang la snying rje yi/ rtsal snang dur khrod gzhal yas khang*/ rab 'bar 'khor lor rtsibs bcu'i dbus/ lha chen pho mo'i gdan steng na/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis/ sras mchog nyer gcig tshogs kyis bskor/ yang sprul grangs med phyogs bcur 'gyed/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ dbus (202)kyis phyogs nas bdud g.yos pa/ bzlog go khro rgyal khyod kyis bzlog bsgyur ro dmar chen gtor mar bsgyur/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis/ yab yum thabs shes rol pa las/ khro bo'i tshogs chen sprul pa ni/ steng 'og phyogs bcu'i rtsibs steng du/ phyogs skyong pho mo gdan steng na/ khro bo'i rgyal po dpal chen bcu/ yum chen khro mo bcu (203)dang 'khril/ sprul pa phar men mgo brnyan tshogs/ yang sprul grangs med phyogs bcur 'phro/ steng 'og phyogs bcu'i gdon dang bgegs/ bzlog go khro rgyal khyed kyis zlog sgyur cig ngan sdig dgra la sgyur/ bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las mjod/ ces dang gzhan yang*/ bhyo/ bzlog bsgyur las la khyed rang mkhas/ lci yang ri bo pang du long*/ dka' yang bdud la rgyu zhags thob/ (204)yas kyis bdud g.yos khyed kyis zlog mas kyi sri la khyed kyis zlog nye ba'i byol po khyed kyis zlog pha tshan rgya 'dre khyed kyis zlog ma bu'i byur 'dre khyed kyis zlog gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor khyed kyis zlog ma mo'i khrag zor khyed kyis zlog bdud kyi khram kha khyed kyis zlog btsan gyi gzer kha khyed kyis zlog sa bdag byad kha khyed kyis zlog rgyal po'i smyo 'bog khyed kyis zlog gza' yi king kang khyed kyis (205)zlog mu stegs ngan sngags khyed kyis zlog the'u brang sris rkun khyed kyis zlog

nad kha rims kha khyed kyis zlog sngags pa'i phur kha khyed kyis zlog bon po'i bon zor khyed kyis zlog sum pa'i glang zer khyod kyis zlog me nyag 'bol le khyed kyis zlog lo zla zhag keg khyed kyis zlog mo ngan rtsis ngan khyed kyis zlog ltas ngan mtshan ngan khyed kyis zlog pho brgya mda' brdar (206)mtshon kha zlog mo brgya dug g.yos zas kha zlog mi nag skye bo'i ya ga zlog bran 'khor ngan pa'i dmod mchu zlog ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog gdon rigs nyi khri chig stong zlog bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlog dus min 'chi dang 'jigs brgyad zlog mi mthun 'gal rkyen thams cad zlog bhyo/ nga ni 'khor 'das (207)kun gyi bdag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ste/ sku chen nga yis bsgyur tsa na/ gzugs khams mi 'gyur gang yang med/ gsung chen nga yis bsgyur tsa na/ sgra skad mi 'gyur gang yang med/ thugs chen nga yi bsgyur tsa na/ sems khams mi 'gyur gang yang med/ de phyir phas rgol mi mthun pa'i/ 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zlog bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog bsgyur ro (208)dpal chen mthu yis sgyur/ zor re dgra dang bgegs la zor/ dpal chen phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mjod/ ces bzlog pa'i phrin las bskul lo/// /
